documents: Original passport, kept by your Indian agent until clearance
Valid work, business or residence visa, or PIO card
Employment or transfer letter showing a stay of 2+ years
Inventory listing every item with its value
Purchase bills for any new or electronic items
Authority letter and customs declaration forms from your agent
FRRO registration (foreign nationals) and India arrival ticket copy
PAN card copy and proof of your new address in India
dutyFree: Used goods owned for 1+ year can get reduced duty under Transfer of Residence
After 2+ years abroad, used household items up to INR 5,00,000 in total qualify
Shorter stays abroad get smaller allowances, starting from INR 60,000
restricted: Banned: firearms, ammunition, narcotics, drones, pornography, ivory and wildlife items
New items and flat-screen TVs pay duty of around 38%
Tobacco over 100 cigarettes, 25 cigars or 125 g is taxed
Alcohol carries very high duty; ask your agent before packing any
Cars face heavy duty and strict rules, and can't enter via Bangalore or Hyderabad
notes: You need 2+ years abroad and under 180 days in India during that time
Ship goods within 1 month of arriving in India (15 days for air)
Arrive before your shipment and stay until it clears; some ports need you present
Foreign nationals can't claim Transfer of Residence relief at Chennai or New Delhi

documents: Full passport copy with visa or FRRO registration
Passport page showing your departure stamp
Signed authority letters and original customs forms from your mover
restricted: Drones need advance approval from several government ministries
Hazardous goods not allowed: batteries, paints, aerosols, fuels, gas tanks, matches
Firearms, ammunition and weapons, including decorative knives and swords
Food, spices, plants, soil, tobacco and medicines may be restricted
Keep valuables out: jewellery, cash, key documents, antiques, expensive art
notes: Take batteries out of all devices, especially laptops
Films, discs and computers may be opened and checked for content
